name: Fantasy Football Calculator
summary: Fantasy football average draft position (ADP) from Fantasy Football Calculator's mock drafts, by scoring format, league size and year, from its free ADP REST API.
notes: Keyless and free for personal and commercial use; attribution (a link or mention) is requested.
Data updates once a day, so do not call it often.
